carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high pixel intensity on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: At least three distinct remora fish are visible as elongated silhouettes in the ventral region below the shark's main body mass.
